# rva-the-fan-
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>RVA — Fan District (v0.4)</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --ink:#14121a; --panel:#221e2e; --panel2:#2e2940; --line:#6c5fa3;
    --paper:#f4efe4; --accent:#e0533d; --teal:#2fa9a2; --gold:#d9a53a;
  }
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
  html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0c0a12;font-family:'Courier New',monospace}
  #stage{position:fixed;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  canvas{image-rendering:pixelated;image-rendering:crisp-edges;display:block}
  .overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:20}
  .overlay.show{display:flex}
  #dlg{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;display:none;z-index:30;padding:10px}
  #dlg.show{display:block}
  #dlgBox{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);
    border:4px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink);padding:12px 14px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.45;position:relative}
  #dlgName{position:absolute;top:-16px;left:10px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;
    border:3px solid var(--ink);padding:2px 10px;font-weight:bold;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1px}
  #dlgText{min-height:44px;white-space:pre-wrap}
  #dlgNext{position:absolute;right:10px;bottom:6px;font-weight:bold;animation:bob .8s infinite}
  @keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(3px)}}
  #dlgChoices{display:none;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
  #dlgChoices.show{display:flex}
  .choiceBtn{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);border:3px solid var(--ink);
    padding:8px 12px;font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
  .choiceBtn:active{transform:translateY(2px)}
  .choiceBtn .sw{width:16px;height:16px;border:2px solid var(--paper);display:inline-block}
  .choiceBtn canvas{border:2px solid var(--paper);background:#3a3550}
  #dlgInputWrap{display:none;margin-top:10px;gap:8px}
  #dlgInputWrap.show{display:flex}
  #dlgInput{flex:1;font-family:inherit;font-size:16px;padding:8px;border:3px solid var(--ink);background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
  #controls{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:15;display:none}
  #controls.show{display:block}
  #joy{position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:18px;width:132px;height:132px;pointer-events:auto;
    user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;touch-action:none}
  #joyBase{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(244,239,228,.10);
    border:2px solid rgba(244,239,228,.4)}
  #joyKnob{position:absolute;left:44px;top:44px;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;
    background:rgba(244,239,228,.22);border:2px solid rgba(244,239,228,.6);pointer-events:none}
  #joy.on #joyKnob{background:rgba(224,83,61,.5)}
  #abtn{position:absolute;right:20px;bottom:34px;width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;
    background:rgba(224,83,61,.35);border:3px solid rgba(244,239,228,.5);color:#f4efe4;
    font-size:20px;font-weight:bold;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    pointer-events:auto;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;touch-action:none}
  #abtn:active{background:rgba(224,83,61,.7)}
  #hud{position:fixed;top:10px;left:10px;right:10px;display:none;z-index:14;pointer-events:none;
    justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start}
  #hud.show{display:flex}
  .hudChip{background:rgba(20,18,26,.82);border:2px solid var(--line);color:var(--paper);
    padding:5px 10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:.5px}
  #hudRight{display:flex;gap:6px}
  #hudRep{color:#e0ac42}
  #hudHealth{color:#4ac06a}
  #toast{position:fixed;top:52px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:35;
    background:var(--ink);color:var(--gold);border:3px solid var(--gold);padding:8px 16px;
    font-weight:bold;font-size:14px;display:none;text-align:center;max-width:90vw}
  #title{background:#0c0a12;flex-direction:column}
  /* ------- LINEUP ------- */
  #lineup{background:#9cc0d4;flex-direction:column;overflow-y:auto;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start}
  #lineupInner{width:min(560px,96vw);padding:14px 8px 24px}
  #lineupTitleBox{background:var(--paper);border:4px solid #4a4a5c;border-radius:4px;
    padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:12px;color:var(--ink);font-weight:bold;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:1px}
  #lineupGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
  @media (max-width:420px){ #lineupGrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)} }
  .presetBtn{background:rgba(255,255,255,.35);border:3px solid rgba(74,74,92,.35);border-radius:4px;
    padding:4px 2px 2px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px}
  .presetBtn.sel{background:#f4efe4;border-color:#4a4a5c}
  .presetBtn canvas{background:transparent}
  .presetBtn .pname{font-size:9px;font-weight:bold;color:#2b2333;text-align:center;line-height:1.1}
  #lineupPanel{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:stretch}
  #heroBox{background:var(--paper);border:4px solid #4a4a5c;border-radius:4px;padding:8px;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0}
  #lineupSide{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
  #heroName{background:var(--paper);border:4px solid #4a4a5c;border-radius:4px;padding:10px;
    color:var(--ink);font-weight:bold;font-size:15px}
  #lineupGo{flex:1;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border:4px solid var(--ink);
    font-family:inherit;font-size:16px;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:1px;cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink);border-radius:4px}
  #lineupGo:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--ink)}
  /* ------- CREATOR ------- */
  #creator{background:linear-gradient(#191527,#0c0a12);overflow-y:auto;align-items:flex-start}
  #creatorInner{width:min(560px,94vw);margin:16px auto;color:var(--paper);padding-bottom:24px}
  #creator h1{font-size:20px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gold);text-align:center;margin-bottom:4px}
  #creator .sub{text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#9a92bd;margin-bottom:12px}
  .crow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px;background:var(--panel);
    border:2px solid var(--panel2);padding:8px}
  .crow label{width:88px;font-size:12px;color:#b7aede;letter-spacing:1px}
  .crow .val{flex:1;text-align:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:bold;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
  .arrow{width:38px;height:38px;background:var(--panel2);color:var(--paper);border:2px solid var(--line);
    font-size:16px;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;flex-shrink:0}
  .arrow:active{background:var(--accent)}
  .crow input[type=text]{flex:1;font-family:inherit;font-size:16px;padding:8px;border:2px solid var(--line);
    background:#141220;color:var(--paper)}

  /* ---- SPRITE LAB CREATOR ---- */
  #creator{overflow-y:auto;align-items:flex-start}
  #slStage{background:var(--panel2);border:3px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;
    padding:12px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:10px}
  .checker{display:inline-block;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);
    background:conic-gradient(#242938 0 25%,#1d2130 0 50%,#242938 0 75%,#1d2130 0) 0 0/16px 16px}
  #slStage canvas,.dircell canvas,#heroCanvas,.presetBtn canvas{image-rendering:pixelated;image-rendering:crisp-edges}
  #slStrip{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
  .dircell{cursor:pointer;padding:5px;border:2px solid var(--line);background:#141220;border-radius:3px}
  .dircell.active{border-color:var(--accent)}
  .dircell span{display:block;font-size:9px;color:#8b8fa3;letter-spacing:1px;text-align:center;margin-top:3px;text-transform:uppercase}
  .slPanel{background:var(--panel2);border:3px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
  .slPanel h2{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#5fb0a5;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:5px;margin-bottom:8px}
  .slPanel .mini{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1px;color:#8b8fa3;text-transform:uppercase;margin:7px 0 4px}
  .chiprow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px}
  .chiprow+.chiprow{margin-top:6px}
  .slchip{font-family:inherit;font-size:11px;padding:6px 9px;cursor:pointer;
    background:#141220;color:var(--paper);border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:3px}
  .slchip.active{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
  .swrow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;margin-top:6px}
  .slswatch{width:26px;height:26px;border:2px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer;padding:0;border-radius:3px}
  .slswatch.active{border-color:#fff;outline:2px solid var(--accent)}
  #startBtn{display:block</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="stage"><canvas id="game"></canvas></div>
<div id="title" class="overlay show"><canvas id="titleCanvas"></canvas></div>

<!-- LINEUP -->
<div id="lineup" class="overlay">
  <div id="lineupInner">
    <div id="lineupTitleBox">Choose your character.</div>
    <div id="lineupGrid"></div>
    <div id="lineupPanel">
      <div id="heroBox"><canvas id="heroCanvas" width="150" height="190"></canvas></div>
      <div id="lineupSide">
        <div id="heroName">—</div>
        <button id="lineupGo">CUSTOMIZE →</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- CREATOR : RVA SPRITE LAB (in-game edition) -->
<div id="creator" class="overlay">
  <div id="creatorInner">
    <h1 id="creatorTitle">MAKE IT YOURS</h1>
    <div class="sub" id="creatorSub">every choice re-editable at your mirror, forever</div>

    <div id="slStage">
      <div class="checker"><canvas id="slMain"></canvas></div>
      <div id="slStrip"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="crow" id="nameRow"><label>NAME</label><input type="text" id="cName" maxlength="14" placeholder="type it" autocomplete="off"></div>
    <div class="crow" id="pronounRow"><label>PRONOUNS</label><button class="arrow" id="proPrev">&lt;</button><div class="val" id="v_pronouns"></div><button class="arrow" id="proNext">&gt;</button></div>

    <div class="slPanel"><h2>Hair</h2>
      <div class="chiprow" id="famRow"></div>
      <div class="chiprow" id="lenRow"></div>
      <div class="swrow" id="hairColors"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="slPanel"><h2>Skin</h2><div class="swrow" id="skinTones"></div></div>
    <div class="slPanel"><h2>Hat</h2>
      <div class="chiprow" id="hatRow"></div>
      <div id="hatDirWrap"><div class="mini">worn</div><div class="chiprow" id="hatDirRow"></div></div>
      <div id="hatColorWrap"><div class="mini">crown</div><div class="swrow" id="hatColors"></div></div>
      <div id="billColorWrap"><div class="mini">bill</div><div class="swrow" id="billColors"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="slPanel"><h2>Top</h2>
      <div class="chiprow" id="topRow"></div>
      <div id="topColorWrap"><div class="swrow" id="topColors"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="slPanel"><h2>Bottom</h2>
      <div class="chiprow" id="botRow"></div>
      <div id="botColorWrap"><div class="swrow" id="botColors"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="slPanel"><h2>Socks</h2>
      <div class="chiprow" id="sockRow"></div>
      <div id="sockColorWrap"><div class="swrow" id="sockColors"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="slPanel"><h2>Shoes</h2><div class="swrow" id="shoeColors"></div></div>

    <button id="startBtn">HIT THE BLOCK &#8594;</button>
    <button id="backToLineup">&#8592; back to the lineup</button>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="hud">
  <div class="hudChip" id="hudBuddy" style="display:none"></div>
  <div id="hudRight">
    <div class="hudChip" id="hudRep">R 0</div>
    <div class="hudChip" id="hudCoins">¢ 0</div>
    <div class="hudChip" id="hudHealth">♥ ▮▮▮▮▮</div>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="toast"></div>

<div id="dlg">
  <div id="dlgBox">
    <div id="dlgName">???</div>
    <div id="dlgText"></div>
    <div id="dlgNext">▼</div>
    <div id="dlgChoices"></div>
    <div id="dlgInputWrap">
      <input type="text" id="dlgInput" maxlength="12" placeholder="name..." autocomplete="off">
      <button class="choiceBtn" id="dlgInputOk">OK</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="controls">
  <div id="joy">
    <div id="joyBase"></div>
    <div id="joyKnob"></div>
  </div>
  <div id="abtn">A</div>
</div>

<script>
"use strict";
/* =========================================================
   RVA — Fan District · v0.4 "Choose Your Fighter"
   NEW: preset lineup (12 Fan archetypes) → hero render →
   deep customization. Two renders, one identity.
   Mohawk. New HUD: Respect / Coins / Health.
   Analog joystick replaces the d-pad for touch movement.
   (Ride system + DCU Fridays challenge = v0.5)
   ========================================================= */

/* =========================================================
   ██ SCRIPT — ALL GAME TEXT LIVES HERE. ██  (script lead: you)
   ========================================================= */
const SCRIPT = {
  ray_name: 'RAY',
  ray_intro: [
    ['???','Yo! Yo— new kid! Hold up!'],
    ['RAY',"Name's Ray. I keep this block. You just moved in, right? Yeah, you got that 'my deposit was how much' look."],
    ['RAY','Listen. Found a whole litter under a porch on Plum Street last night. Momma never came back.'],
    ['RAY',"I can keep two of 'em warm at my spot. But one of these lil' guys needs a person. That's you."],
  ],
  ray_pick: 'Go on. Which one?',
  ray_picked: 'Good eye. That one bit me twice, which means it has leadership qualities.',
  ray_drip: "Now the important part. What's the drip?",
  ray_dripcolor: 'Color?',
  ray_askname: 'And the name. Choose wisely — the block will know it.',
  ray_christen: (name)=>`${name}. That is a Fan possum if I ever saw one.`,
  ray_outro: [
    ['RAY',"They'll follow you now. Trash cans are a gold mine with a nose like that — try one."],
    ['RAY',"Take care of each other. I'm around if you need wisdom. Or if you find snacks."],
  ],
  ray_idle: [
    'The river does not hurry, and yet it arrives. Think about that.',
    'Helga pays Fridays. Tips are better when it rains. Nobody knows why.',
    'Saw a rat carry a whole slice of pizza up Strawberry St. Respect.',
    'Take care of the little ones and the block takes care of you.',
    "Cops circled twice today. Third time means somebody's party is too good.",
  ],
  ray_idle_buddy: (buddy)=>`${buddy}'s looking strong. Trash cans, kid. That's where the economy is.`,
  sign: 'W MAIN ST.\nBrick sidewalks, buckled by tree roots since forever. Watch your step.',
  hydrant: 'A fire hydrant. Someone has knitted a tiny sweater onto it.\nThis is normal here.',
  scooters_1: 'A pile of rental scooters blocks the entire sidewalk.\nClassic.',
  scooters_ask: 'Tip one over?',
  scooters_yes: 'Obviously', scooters_no: 'Rise above it',
  scooters_toast: 'petty. satisfying. +1 REP',
  scooters_after: 'One of them lies on its side.\nYou feel nothing. (You feel a little something.)',
  trash_loot: (buddy)=>`${buddy} dives in headfirst.\n...and emerges with ¢3 and half a bagel. +¢3`,
  trash_empty: (buddy)=>`Already picked clean. ${buddy} looks proud about it.`,
  trash_nobuddy: 'A city trash can. It smells like it knows things.\nIf only you had a small associate who works in this field.',
  helga_1: 'A dive bar. The neon hums. A sign on the door:',
  helga_2: '"OPENS AT 5. NO SCOOTERS INSIDE. YES WE\'RE HIRING."\n\n(soon: get a job here.)',
  raccoons_1: 'The bar next door. A chalkboard out front reads:',
  raccoons_2: '"TRIVIA TONIGHT. WINNER GETS A PITCHER AND OUR RESPECT."\n\n(script: yours to write.)',
  catwindow: 'A cat watches you from a second-story window.\nIt is judging you. It will remember this.\n\n(One day: rescuable.)',
  home_enter_toast: 'HOME — your (rented) castle',
  home_exit_toast: 'WEST MAIN ST',
  mirror_prompt: 'The mirror is smudged but honest.\nChange it up?',
  mirror_yes: 'New look', mirror_no: 'Nah, I look great',
  bed: "Your bed. A mattress on a frame you found on Grove Ave with a 'FREE' sign.\nIt has served with honor.",
  window_home: 'Out the window: the block, the bricks, somebody arguing about a parking spot.\nHome.',
  basket: (buddy)=>buddy? `${buddy}'s basket. There is exactly one (1) sock in it.\nDo not ask where it came from.` : 'A small empty basket. As if waiting for someone.',
  plant: "A basil plant. Still alive. You're doing great.",
  street_open_hint: 'Explore. Someone wants to meet you.',
  possum_joined: (name)=>'★ '+name+' joined you!',
};
/* ================== END SCRIPT BLOCK ===================== */

// ---------- helpers ----------
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const clamp = (v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const rand = (seed=>()=> (seed = (seed*16807)%2147483647)/2147483647)(1987);
function px(ctx,x,y,w,h,c){ ctx.fillStyle=c; ctx.fillRect(Math.round(x),Math.round(y),w,h); }

// ---------- state ----------
const G = {
  mode:'title', map:'street',
  coins:0, rep:0, health:5,
  player:{ x:70, y:200, dir:'down', frame:0, moving:false, speed:1.5,
    name:'', pronouns_i:0,
    family:'Buzz / Fade', len:'Short', hair:0, skin:2,
    hat:'none', hatDir:'fwd', hatColor:0, hatBill:0,
    top:'fitted', topColor:0, bottom:'jeans', botColor:0,
    sock:'none', sockColor:0, shoeColor:0 },
  possum:null,
  ray:{ x:500, y:200, dir:'left', frame:0, met:false, approaching:false },
  camX:0, camY:0, keys:{}, joy:{x:0,y:0,active:false},
  trail:[], flags:{ scooterKicked:false, trashLooted:{}, rayIdle:0 },
  homeReturn:{x:0,y:0}, t:0
};

// ---------- option tables ----------
const PRONOUNS = ['they/them','she/her','he/him','any/all'];
const POSSUM_COLORS = [
  {n:'Blue-Gray', body:'#939cb2', face:'#ecf0f6', dark:'#646c82'},
  {n:'Gray',      body:'#a4a4a4', face:'#f3f3f3', dark:'#747474'},
  {n:'Tan-Brown', body:'#b8956b', face:'#f3e7d3', dark:'#856745'}
];
const ACCESSORIES = ['Chain','Bandana','Collar'];
const ACC_COLORS = [
  {n:'Red',c:'#d93a3a'},{n:'Teal',c:'#2fa9a2'},{n:'Gold',c:'#d9a53a'},{n:'Purple',c:'#8a5ad9'}
];
const OUT = '#2b2333';
const idx = (arr,n)=>{ const i=arr.findIndex(v=>(typeof v==='string'?v:v.n)===n); return i<0?0:i; };

// ---------- THE LINEUP: 12 Fan archetypes (Sprite Lab spec) ----------
// hair = HAIRCOLORS idx | skin = SKINS idx | topColor/botColor/sockColor/shoeColor = palette idx
const PRESETS = [
  {name:'The Bartender', cfg:{family:'Buzz / Fade',len:'Short',hair:0,skin:2,hat:'none',top:'fitted',topColor:1,bottom:'jeans',botColor:2,sock:'none',shoeColor:0}},
  {name:'Art Kid',       cfg:{family:'Wolf Cut',len:'Medium',hair:5,skin:0,hat:'none',top:'crop',topColor:3,bottom:'skirt',botColor:2,sock:'high',sockColor:6,shoeColor:1}},
  {name:'Porch Elder',   cfg:{family:'Afro',len:'Short',hair:0,skin:4,hat:'bucket',hatDir:'fwd',hatColor:0,top:'oversize',topColor:2,bottom:'jshorts',botColor:3,sock:'mid',sockColor:1,shoeColor:5}},
  {name:'The Punk',      cfg:{family:'Buzz / Fade',len:'Short',hair:6,skin:0,hat:'none',top:'tank',topColor:1,bottom:'jeans',botColor:2,sock:'high',sockColor:4,shoeColor:2}},
  {name:'Skate Rat',     cfg:{family:'Curly',len:'Short',hair:1,skin:2,hat:'beanie',hatDir:'back',hatColor:0,top:'oversize',topColor:8,bottom:'jshorts',botColor:2,sock:'high',sockColor:0,shoeColor:1}},
  {name:'Barista',       cfg:{family:'Straight',len:'Short',hair:4,skin:3,hat:'none',top:'fitted',topColor:4,bottom:'jeans',botColor:6,sock:'none',shoeColor:5}},
  {name:'Jog Guy',       cfg:{family:'Buzz / Fade',len:'Short',hair:3,skin:1,hat:'five',hatDir:'fwd',hatColor:0,top:'tank',topColor:0,bottom:'ashorts',botColor:8,sock:'noshow',sockColor:0,shoeColor:1}},
  {name:'Line Cook',     cfg:{family:'Curly',len:'Short',hair:0,skin:3,hat:'snap',hatDir:'back',hatColor:0,top:'fitted',topColor:0,bottom:'jeans',botColor:2,sock:'mid',sockColor:4,shoeColor:0}},
  {name:'Thrift Queen',  cfg:{family:'Curly',len:'Long',hair:5,skin:5,hat:'none',top:'crop',topColor:11,bottom:'skirt',botColor:9,sock:'mid',sockColor:2,shoeColor:8}},
  {name:'DCU Kid',       cfg:{family:'Straight',len:'Medium',hair:0,skin:2,hat:'snap',hatDir:'fwd',hatColor:2,top:'fitted',topColor:10,bottom:'jeans',botColor:1,sock:'none',shoeColor:3}},
  {name:'Messenger',     cfg:{family:'Locs',len:'Short',hair:0,skin:4,hat:'none',top:'crop',topColor:5,bottom:'jeans',botColor:2,sock:'mid',sockColor:3,shoeColor:6}},
  {name:'The Regular',   cfg:{family:'Straight',len:'Medium',hair:2,skin:1,hat:'none',top:'fitted',topColor:11,bottom:'jshorts',botColor:0,sock:'noshow',sockColor:0,shoeColor:4}},
];
const LOOK_DEFAULTS = {hat:'none',hatDir:'fwd',hatColor:0,hatBill:0,sock:'none',sockColor:0};
function applyPreset(p){
  Object.assign(G.player, LOOK_DEFAULTS, p.cfg);
  invalidatePlayerSprite();
}

// =========================================================
//  RVA SPRITE LAB ENGINE v1 — canonical character system
//  (32x32 layered grids: hat > hair > top > bottom > sock > undies > base)

/* =====================================================================
   HAT LIBRARY (v1.4)
   Chars:  P hat main   A hat accent/band   B bill/brim
   Architecture:
   - Hat orientation (fwd/back/sideL/sideR) is INDEPENDENT of facing.
     Renderer composes: hat style x hat orientation x facing direction.
   - Only down/right/up are authored. Facing LEFT mirrors facing RIGHT
     with sideL<->sideR swapped so orientation stays true to the character.
   - Within a symmetric facing (down/up), sideR auto-mirrors sideL.
   - Missing orientations fall back to fwd (beanie/bucket are symmetric;
     beanie "back" = slouch variant).
   TUCK SYSTEM:
   - Each hair family declares a tuck mode in TUCK_BY_FAMILY:
       none      buzz/fade — hat sits over, hair untouched
       clip      straight/wolf/locs — rows above the hatline are removed,
                 length below the brim is kept
       compress  afro/curly — currently behaves as clip (volume below the
                 hatline survives, reading as squeezed puff). Any style can
                 later add hand-drawn hat_down / hat_right / hat_up grids,
                 which override the procedural tuck automatically.
   - Hatline = first sprite row NOT covered by the hat. Per-orientation
     (backward caps sit higher -> more forehead/fringe).
   ===================================================================== */

const TUCK_BY_FAMILY = {
  "Buzz / Fade":"none",
  "Afro":"compress",
  "Curly":"compress",
  "Wolf Cut":"clip",
  "Straight":"clip",
  "Locs":"clip"
};

function hatlineFor(hat, orient){
  const h = hat.hatline;
  return (typeof h === "number") ? h : (h[orient] !== undefined ? h[orient] : 8);
}

function hatGridFor(hat, facing, orient){
  if(facing === "left"){
    const swap = {fwd:"fwd", back:"back", sideL:"sideR", sideR:"sideL"};
    const g = hatGridFor(hat, "right", swap[orient]);
    return g ? mirror(g) : null;
  }
  const set = hat[facing];
  if(!set) return null;
  let g = set[orient];
  if(!g && orient === "sideR" && set.sideL) g = mirror(set.sideL);
  if(!g) g = set.fwd;
  return g;
}

   - The base body is LOCKED: clothing paints over it, never reshapes it.
   - One grid per item, shared across down/right/up facings (torso pixels
     are identical); left facing mirrors. Per-facing overrides can be
     added later as item.down/right/up fields.
   - Layer order (top wins): Hat > Hair > Top > Bottom > Underwear > Base.
   - Underwear always renders so "None" selections stay decent.
   ===================================================================== */

/* ---------------- RENDERER ---------------- */

function mirror(grid){ return grid.map(r => r.split("").reverse().join("")); }

function getGrids(o, dir){
  const style = Object.values(HAIR).find(s=>s.family===o.family && s.len===o.len)
             || Object.values(HAIR)[0];
  const hat = HATS[o.hat];
  const active = hat && hat.key !== "none";
  const pick = d => (active && style["hat_"+d]) || style[d];
  let base, hair, drawn;
  if(dir==="down"){       base=BASE_DOWN;          hair=pick("down");          drawn=!!style.hat_down; }
  else if(dir==="up"){    base=BASE_UP;            hair=pick("up");            drawn=!!style.hat_up; }
  else if(dir==="right"){ base=BASE_RIGHT;         hair=pick("right");         drawn=!!style.hat_right; }
  else {                  base=mirror(BASE_RIGHT); hair=mirror(pick("right")); drawn=!!style.hat_right; }
  // clothing layers: one grid per item, mirrored for left facing
  const mir = (dir==="left");
  const cg = o => { const g=(o||{}).grid||[]; return mir ? mirror(g) : g; };
  const topG = cg(TOPS[o.top]);
  const botG = cg(BOTTOMS[o.bottom]);
  const sockG = cg(SOCKS[o.sock]);
  const undG = mir ? mirror(UNDIES) : UNDIES;
  let hatG = [];
  if(active){
    const mode = TUCK_BY_FAMILY[style.family] || "clip";
    if(!drawn && mode !== "none"){
      const line = hatlineFor(hat, o.hatDir);
      const vent = hat.vent && hat.vent[(dir==="left"?"right":dir)+":"+o.hatDir];
      hair = hair.map((row,y)=>{
        if(y >= line) return row;
        if(vent && y >= vent.r[0] && y <= vent.r[1]){
          const rr=(row||_).padEnd(32,".");
          let out="";
          for(let x=0;x<32;x++) out += (x>=vent.c[0] && x<=vent.c[1]) ? rr[x] : ".";
          return out;
        }
        return _;
      });
    }
    hatG = hatGridFor(hat, dir, o.hatDir) || [];
  }
  /* priority order, first wins: hat > hair > top > bottom > sock > underwear > base */
  return [hatG, hair, topG, botG, sockG, undG, base];
}

function colorFor(o, ch){
  const hc = HAIRCOLORS[o.hair], sk = SKINS[o.skin];
  switch(ch){
    case "H": return hc.H; case "D": return hc.D; case "L": return hc.L;
    case "s": return sk.s; case "t": return sk.t;
    case "c": return TOPCOLORS[o.topColor].c;
    case "k": return TOPCOLORS[o.topColor].k;
    case "p": return BOTCOLORS[o.botColor].p;
    case "q": return BOTCOLORS[o.botColor].q;
    case "w": return SOCKCOLORS[o.sockColor].w;
    case "h": return SHOECOLORS[o.shoeColor].h;
    case "v": return SOCKCOLORS[o.sockColor].v;
    case "P": case "A": case "B": {
      if(ch === "B" && o.hatBill > 0) return HATCOLORS[o.hatBill].B;
      const hcol = HATCOLORS[o.hatColor];
      const hp = (hcol && hcol.P) ? hcol : ((HATS[o.hat]||{}).pal || {});
      return hp[ch] || null;
    }
    default:  return FIXED[ch] || null;
  }
}

function drawSpriteTo(canvas, o, dir, scale){
  canvas.width = 32*scale; canvas.height = 32*scale;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
  const layers = getGrids(o, dir);
  for(let y=0;y<32;y++){
    const rows = layers.map(g => (g[y]||_).padEnd(32,"."));
    for(let x=0;x<32;x++){
      let ch=null, li=-1;
      for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
        if(rows[i][x] !== "."){ ch=rows[i][x]; li=i; break; }
      }
      if(ch===null) continue;
      const isInk = (li<=1); /* hat + hair count as ink for the silhouette test */
      let col;
      if(o.sil){
        col = isInk ? "#0c0d12" : (ch==="o" ? "#b3afa6" : "#d4d0c7");
      } else {
        col = colorFor(o, ch);
      }
      if(!col) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = col;
      ctx.fillRect(x*scale, y*scale, scale, scale);
    }
  }
}


// =========================================================
//  PLAYER IN-WORLD RENDER — cached sprite canvases + walk bob
// =========================================================
const SPRITE_CACHE = { dirty:true, cv:{} };
function invalidatePlayerSprite(){ SPRITE_CACHE.dirty = true; }
function ensurePlayerSprites(){
  if(!SPRITE_CACHE.dirty) return;
  for(const d of ['down','up','left','right']){
    const cv = SPRITE_CACHE.cv[d] || (SPRITE_CACHE.cv[d] = document.createElement('canvas'));
    drawSpriteTo(cv, G.player, d, 1);
  }
  SPRITE_CACHE.dirty = false;
}
/* base grids: feet occupy rows 24-25, so the baseline (ground contact) is row 26.
   anchor sprite so row 26 lands on feetY; content is ~23px tall = same scale as Ray. */
const SPRITE_FEET_ROW = 26;
function drawPlayerWorld(c){
  ensurePlayerSprites();
  const p = G.player;
  const bob = p.moving ? (Math.floor(p.frame/7)%2) : 0;
  // soft ground shadow
  c.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,18,26,.22)';
  c.fillRect(Math.round(p.x-6), Math.round(p.y-1), 12, 2);
  c.drawImage(SPRITE_CACHE.cv[p.dir], Math.round(p.x-16), Math.round(p.y-SPRITE_FEET_ROW-bob));
}

// --- Ray, chibi legend ---
function drawRayChibi(ctx, cx, feetY, frame, dir){
  ctx.save(); ctx.scale(0.5,0.5);
  const F=(x,y,w,h,c)=>{ ctx.fillStyle=c; ctx.fillRect(x,y,w,h); };
  const sx=Math.round(cx*2), bot=Math.round(feetY*2);
  const step=Math.floor(frame/8)%2;
  const hy=bot-46;
  F(sx-7,bot-11,6,11,OUT); F(sx+1,bot-11,6,11,OUT);
  F(sx-6,bot-10,4,7,'#544a3a'); F(sx+2,bot-10,4,7,'#544a3a');
  F(sx-6,bot-4,4,4,'#38301f'); F(sx+2,bot-4,4,4,'#38301f');
  F(sx-10,hy+22,20,15,OUT);
  F(sx-9,hy+23,18,13,'#75643f');
  F(sx-9,hy+23,3,13,'#87754e'); F(sx+6,hy+23,3,13,'#87754e');
  F(sx-4,hy+24,8,11,'#9a3644');
  F(sx-4,hy+28,8,1,'#722530'); F(sx-1,hy+24,1,11,'#722530');
  F(sx-14,hy+23+(step?1:0),4,11,OUT); F(sx+10,hy+23+(step?0:1),4,11,OUT);
  F(sx-13,hy+24+(step?1:0),3,9,'#75643f'); F(sx+11,hy+24+(step?0:1),3,9,'#75643f');
  F(sx-13,hy+31,3,3,'#d49c6b'); F(sx+11,hy+31,3,3,'#d49c6b');
  F(sx-12,hy+2,24,19,OUT); F(sx-11,hy,22,22,OUT);
  F(sx-10,hy+1,20,20,'#d49c6b');
  F(sx+7,hy+4,2,12,'#b47a45');
  F(sx-10,hy+12,20,9,'#c2bbae'); F(sx-8,hy+21,16,3,'#c2bbae');
  F(sx-10,hy+19,20,1,'#a29a8c'); F(sx-6,hy+23,12,1,'#a29a8c');
  let e1=sx-7,e2=sx+2;
  if(dir==='left'){e1=sx-9;e2=sx;}
  if(dir==='right'){e1=sx-4;e2=sx+5;}
  for(const ex of [e1,e2]){
    F(ex,hy+6,4,5,OUT); F(ex+1,hy+7,2,3,'#5a4426'); F(ex+1,hy+7,1,1,'#fff');
  }
  F(e1-1,hy+4,6,2,'#c2bbae'); F(e2-1,hy+4,6,2,'#c2bbae');
  F(sx-12,hy-4,24,6,OUT); F(sx-11,hy-3,22,5,'#476a9c');
  if(dir==='left'){ F(sx-19,hy,10,3,'#324d74'); }
  else if(dir==='right'){ F(sx+9,hy,10,3,'#324d74'); }
  else if(dir==='down'){ F(sx-10,hy+1,20,3,'#324d74'); }
  ctx.restore();
}

// --- possum ---
function drawPossum(ctx, cx, feetY, p, frame, dir){
  ctx.save(); ctx.scale(0.5,0.5);
  const F=(x,y,w,h,c)=>{ ctx.fillStyle=c; ctx.fillRect(x,y,w,h); };
  const sx=Math.round(cx*2), bot=Math.round(feetY*2);
  const C=POSSUM_COLORS[p.color];
  const flip = dir==='left';
  const m = v => flip? -v : v;
  const y0=bot-20;
  F(sx+m(-16),y0+6,6,3,OUT); F(sx+m(-15),y0+7,5,1,'#e0a8a8');
  F(sx+m(-18),y0+3,4,4,OUT); F(sx+m(-17),y0+4,2,2,'#e0a8a8');
  F(sx-11,y0+3,22,12,OUT);
  F(sx-10,y0+4,20,10,C.body);
  F(sx-10,y0+10,20,4,C.dark);
  F(sx-8,y0+4,10,2,'#ffffff2e');
  const hxp = sx+m(6);
  F(hxp-7,y0-4,15,14,OUT);
  F(hxp-6,y0-3,13,12,C.face);
  F(hxp+m(6),y0+1,3,4,OUT); F(hxp+m(6),y0+2,2,2,C.face);
  F(hxp+m(8),y0+2,2,2,'#eda8ba');
  F(hxp+m(-5)-2,y0-7,5,5,OUT); F(hxp+m(-5)-1,y0-6,3,3,C.dark);
  F(hxp+m(2)-2,y0-7,5,5,OUT); F(hxp+m(2)-1,y0-6,3,3,C.dark);
  F(hxp+m(-5)-1,y0-5,2,1,'#eda8ba');
  F(hxp+m(1),y0,4,5,OUT); F(hxp+m(1)+1,y0+1,2,3,'#2b2333');
  F(hxp+m(1)+1,y0+1,1,1,'#fff');
  const s=Math.floor(frame/7)%2;
  F(sx-8,y0+14+(s?0:2),3,4,C.dark); F(sx-2,y0+14+(s?2:0),3,4,C.dark);
  F(sx+4,y0+14+(s?0:2),3,4,C.dark);
  const nx = sx+m(2);
  const ac = ACC_COLORS[p.accColor].c;
  if(p.accessory==='Chain'){ F(nx-2,y0+6,7,2,'#efdb84'); F(nx,y0+8,3,2,ac); }
  else if(p.accessory==='Bandana'){ F(nx-3,y0+6,9,3,ac); F(nx-1,y0+9,4,3,ac); F(nx-3,y0+8,9,1,'#00000022'); }
  else if(p.accessory==='Collar'){ F(nx-2,y0+6,7,2,ac); F(nx,y0+8,3,2,'#efdb84'); }
  ctx.restore();
}

// =========================================================
//  TITLE
// =========================================================
const titleCv = $('titleCanvas');
function drawTitle(){
  const W=Math.min(window.innerWidth,640), H=window.innerHeight;
  titleCv.width=W; titleCv.height=H;
  const c=titleCv.getContext('2d'); c.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
  c.fillStyle='#0c0a12'; c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  const sy=H*0.62, scale=3;
  c.save(); c.translate(0,sy); c.scale(scale,scale);
  const cols=['#cc5540','#e0ac42','#7a8f6a','#8f6a7a','#5f7a8f','#b3763f'];
  let bx=0,i=0;
  while(bx<W/scale){
    const bw=18+Math.floor(rand()*8), bh=26+Math.floor(rand()*14);
    c.fillStyle=cols[i%cols.length]; c.fillRect(bx,-bh,bw,bh);
    c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.25)'; c.fillRect(bx,-bh,bw,3);
    c.fillStyle='#ffe9a8';
    for(let wy=-bh+6;wy<-6;wy+=8)for(let wx=bx+3;wx<bx+bw-3;wx+=6)
      if(rand()>0.45)c.fillRect(wx,wy,2,3);
    bx+=bw+2;i++;
  }
  c.fillStyle='#1a1626'; c.fillRect(0,0,W/scale,60);
  c.fillStyle='#e0ac42';
  for(let lx=4;lx<W/scale;lx+=16)c.fillRect(lx,8,6,1);
  c.restore();
  const g=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,sy);
  g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(122,77,143,0.25)'); g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(224,83,61,0.15)');
  c.fillStyle=g; c.fillRect(0,0,W,sy);
  c.save(); c.translate(W/2,H*0.30); c.transform(1,0,-0.18,1,0,0);
  const size=Math.min(W*0.42,190);
  c.font=`900 ${size}px 'Arial Black', Impact, sans-serif`;
  c.textAlign='center'; c.textBaseline='middle'; c.lineJoin='round';
  c.strokeStyle='#0c0a12'; c.lineWidth=size*0.14; c.strokeText('RVA',0,0);
  c.fillStyle='#f4efe4'; c.fillText('RVA',0,0);
  c.strokeStyle='#e0533d'; c.lineWidth=size*0.045; c.strokeText('RVA',0,0);
  c.restore();
  c.font=`bold ${Math.min(W*0.05,22)}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  c.textAlign='center'; c.fillStyle='#e0ac42';
  c.fillText('F A N   D I S T R I C T', W/2, H*0.30+Math.min(W*0.42,190)*0.62);
  if(Math.floor(Date.now()/600)%2===0){
    c.fillStyle='#f4efe4'; c.font='bold 16px "Courier New", monospace';
    c.fillText('— TAP TO START —', W/2, H*0.86);
  }
  c.fillStyle='#5c5480'; c.font='12px "Courier New", monospace';
  c.fillText('v0.4 · choose your fighter', W/2, H-16);
}
let titleTimer=setInterval(()=>{ if(G.mode==='title')drawTitle(); },300);
drawTitle();
$('title').addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{
  if(G.mode!=='title')return;
  G.mode='lineup';
  $('title').classList.remove('show');
  openLineup();
});

// =========================================================
//  LINEUP SCREEN
// =========================================================
let selectedPreset=0;
function openLineup(){
  const grid=$('lineupGrid');
  if(!grid.dataset.built){
    PRESETS.forEach((p,i)=>{
      const b=document.createElement('button'); b.className='presetBtn'; b.dataset.i=i;
      const cv=document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width=52; cv.height=56;
      b.appendChild(cv);
      const nm=document.createElement('div'); nm.className='pname'; nm.textContent=p.name;
      b.appendChild(nm);
      b.addEventListener('click',()=>selectPreset(i));
      grid.appendChild(b);
    });
    grid.dataset.built='1';
  }
  // draw all tiny sprites (sprite lab, front view)
  PRESETS.forEach((p,i)=>{
    const cv=grid.children[i].querySelector('canvas');
    drawSpriteTo(cv, {...G.player, ...LOOK_DEFAULTS, ...p.cfg}, 'down', 2);
  });
  $('lineup').classList.add('show');
  selectPreset(selectedPreset);
}
function selectPreset(i){
  selectedPreset=i;
  document.querySelectorAll('.presetBtn').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('sel', +b.dataset.i===i));
  applyPreset(PRESETS[i]);
  $('heroName').textContent = PRESETS[i].name;
  drawSpriteTo($('heroCanvas'), G.player, 'down', 4);
}
$('lineupGo').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  $('lineup').classList.remove('show');
  G.mode='creator';
  openCreator(false);
});

// =========================================================
//  CREATOR — RVA SPRITE LAB (in-game edition)
// =========================================================
let creatorFromMirror=false, creatorBuilt=false, previewDir='down';

function lensFor(fam){
  const order=['Short','Medium','Long'];
  return order.filter(L=>Object.values(HAIR).some(s=>s.family===fam && s.len===L));
}
function hatDirsFor(hatKey){
  const hat=HATS[hatKey]; if(!hat || hat.key==='none') return [];
  const dirs=new Set();
  for(const f of ['down','right','up']) if(hat[f]) Object.keys(hat[f]).forEach(k=>dirs.add(k));
  if(dirs.has('sideL')) dirs.add('sideR'); // mirroring covers the other side
  return ['fwd','back','sideL','sideR'].filter(d=>dirs.has(d));
}
const HATDIR_LABEL={fwd:'Forward',back:'Backward',sideL:'Side L',sideR:'Side R'};
const BEANIE_LABEL={fwd:'Fitted',back:'Slouch'};

function slChip(txt,fn){ const b=document.createElement('button'); b.className='slchip'; b.textContent=txt; b.onclick=fn; return b; }
function slSwatch(bg,title,fn){ const s=document.createElement('button'); s.className='slswatch'; s.style.background=bg; s.title=title; s.onclick=fn; return s; }
function touchLook(){ invalidatePlayerSprite(); syncCreator(); renderCreatorPreviews(); }

function buildCreator(){
  const P=G.player;
  // direction strip
  const strip=$('slStrip');
  ['down','left','right','up'].forEach(dir=>{
    const cell=document.createElement('div');
    cell.className='dircell'; cell.dataset.dir=dir;
    const cv=document.createElement('canvas');
    const lb=document.createElement('span'); lb.textContent=dir;
    cell.appendChild(cv); cell.appendChild(lb);
    cell.onclick=()=>{ previewDir=dir; renderCreatorPreviews(); };
    strip.appendChild(cell);
  });
  // hair families + colors
  const fams=[...new Set(Object.values(HAIR).map(s=>s.family))];
  fams.forEach(f=>{
    const c=slChip(f,()=>{ P.family=f; const L=lensFor(f); if(!L.includes(P.len)) P.len=L[0]; rebuildLenChips(); touchLook(); });
    c.dataset.fam=f; $('famRow').appendChild(c);
  });
  rebuildLenChips();
  HAIRCOLORS.forEach((hc,i)=>$('hairColors').appendChild(slSwatch(hc.H,hc.name,()=>{P.hair=i;touchLook();})));
  // skin
  SKINS.forEach((sk,i)=>$('skinTones').appendChild(slSwatch(sk.s,sk.name,()=>{P.skin=i;touchLook();})));
  // hats
  Object.keys(HATS).forEach(k=>{
    const c=slChip(HATS[k].name,()=>{ P.hat=k; const ds=hatDirsFor(k); if(ds.length&&!ds.includes(P.hatDir)) P.hatDir='fwd'; rebuildHatDirChips(); touchLook(); });
    c.dataset.hat=k; $('hatRow').appendChild(c);
  });
  rebuildHatDirChips();
  HATCOLORS.forEach((hc,i)=>{
    const bg = hc.P || 'linear-gradient(135deg,#2f9e8f 25%,#b5382f 25%,#b5382f 50%,#7d5ba6 50%,#7d5ba6 75%,#d9a93f 75%)';
    $('hatColors').appendChild(slSwatch(bg,hc.name,()=>{P.hatColor=i;touchLook();}));
  });
  HATCOLORS.forEach((hc,i)=>{
    $('billColors').appendChild(slSwatch(i===0?'#8a8578':hc.B, i===0?'Match crown':hc.name, ()=>{P.hatBill=i;touchLook();}));
  });
  // tops / bottoms / socks / shoes
  Object.keys(TOPS).forEach(k=>{ const c=slChip(TOPS[k].name,()=>{P.top=k;touchLook();}); c.dataset.top=k; $('topRow').appendChild(c); });
  TOPCOLORS.forEach((tc,i)=>$('topColors').appendChild(slSwatch(tc.c,tc.name,()=>{P.topColor=i;touchLook();})));
  Object.keys(BOTTOMS).forEach(k=>{ const c=slChip(BOTTOMS[k].name,()=>{P.bottom=k;touchLook();}); c.dataset.bottom=k; $('botRow').appendChild(c); });
  BOTCOLORS.forEach((bc,i)=>$('botColors').appendChild(slSwatch(bc.p,bc.name,()=>{P.botColor=i;touchLook();})));
  Object.keys(SOCKS).forEach(k=>{ const c=slChip(SOCKS[k].name,()=>{P.sock=k;touchLook();}); c.dataset.sock=k; $('sockRow').appendChild(c); });
  SOCKCOLORS.forEach((sc,i)=>$('sockColors').appendChild(slSwatch(sc.w,sc.name,()=>{P.sockColor=i;touchLook();})));
  SHOECOLORS.forEach((sh,i)=>$('shoeColors').appendChild(slSwatch(sh.h,sh.name,()=>{P.shoeColor=i;touchLook();})));
  // pronouns
  const spin=d=>{ P.pronouns_i=(P.pronouns_i+d+PRONOUNS.length)%PRONOUNS.length; $('v_pronouns').textContent=PRONOUNS[P.pronouns_i]; };
  $('proPrev').onclick=()=>spin(-1); $('proNext').onclick=()=>spin(1);
  creatorBuilt=true;
}
function rebuildLenChips(){
  const row=$('lenRow'); row.innerHTML='';
  lensFor(G.player.family).forEach(L=>{
    const c=slChip(L,()=>{G.player.len=L;touchLook();}); c.dataset.len=L; row.appendChild(c);
  });
}
function rebuildHatDirChips(){
  const row=$('hatDirRow'); row.innerHTML='';
  const isBeanie = G.player.hat==='beanie';
  hatDirsFor(G.player.hat).forEach(d=>{
    const c=slChip((isBeanie&&BEANIE_LABEL[d])||HATDIR_LABEL[d],()=>{G.player.hatDir=d;touchLook();});
    c.dataset.hatdir=d; row.appendChild(c);
  });
}
function syncCreator(){
  const P=G.player;
  const mark=(sel,test)=>document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(el=>el.classList.toggle('active',test(el)));
  mark('#famRow .slchip',   el=>el.dataset.fam===P.family);
  mark('#lenRow .slchip',   el=>el.dataset.len===P.len);
  mark('#hatRow .slchip',   el=>el.dataset.hat===P.hat);
  mark('#hatDirRow .slchip',el=>el.dataset.hatdir===P.hatDir);
  mark('#topRow .slchip',   el=>el.dataset.top===P.top);
  mark('#botRow .slchip',   el=>el.dataset.bottom===P.bottom);
  mark('#sockRow .slchip',  el=>el.dataset.sock===P.sock);
  const swMark=(id,val)=>document.querySelectorAll('#'+id+' .slswatch').forEach((s,i)=>s.classList.toggle('active',i===val));
  swMark('hairColors',P.hair); swMark('skinTones',P.skin);
  swMark('hatColors',P.hatColor); swMark('billColors',P.hatBill);
  swMark('topColors',P.topColor); swMark('botColors',P.botColor);
  swMark('sockColors',P.sockColor); swMark('shoeColors',P.shoeColor);
  const hatOn = P.hat!=='none';
  $('hatDirWrap').style.display   = (hatOn && hatDirsFor(P.hat).length>1) ? '' : 'none';
  $('hatColorWrap').style.display = hatOn ? '' : 'none';
  $('billColorWrap').style.display= (hatOn && HATS[P.hat].hasBill) ? '' : 'none';
  $('topColorWrap').style.display = (P.top==='none') ? 'none' : '';
  $('botColorWrap').style.display = (P.bottom==='none') ? 'none' : '';
  $('sockColorWrap').style.display= (P.sock==='none') ? 'none' : '';
  $('v_pronouns').textContent = PRONOUNS[P.pronouns_i];
}
function renderCreatorPreviews(){
  drawSpriteTo($('slMain'), G.player, previewDir, 4);
  document.querySelectorAll('#slStrip .dircell').forEach(cell=>{
    drawSpriteTo(cell.querySelector('canvas'), G.player, cell.dataset.dir, 2);
    cell.classList.toggle('active', cell.dataset.dir===previewDir);
  });
}
function openCreator(fromMirror){
  creatorFromMirror=fromMirror;
  $('creatorTitle').textContent=fromMirror?'NEW LOOK':'MAKE IT YOURS';
  $('creatorSub').textContent=fromMirror?'same you, different you':'every choice re-editable at your mirror, forever';
  $('nameRow').style.display=fromMirror?'none':'flex';
  $('pronounRow').style.display=fromMirror?'none':'flex';
  $('backToLineup').style.display=fromMirror?'none':'block';
  $('startBtn').textContent=fromMirror?'LOOKING GOOD \u2192':'HIT THE BLOCK \u2192';
  if(!creatorBuilt) buildCreator();
  rebuildLenChips(); rebuildHatDirChips();
  $('creator').classList.add('show');
  syncCreator(); renderCreatorPreviews();
}
$('backToLineup').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  $('creator').classList.remove('show');
  G.mode='lineup';
  openLineup();
});
$('startBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  invalidatePlayerSprite();
  if(!creatorFromMirror){
    G.player.name=($('cName').value.trim()||'Kid');
    $('creator').classList.remove('show');
    startPlay();
  } else {
    $('creator').classList.remove('show');
    toast('fresh.');
  }
});

//  WORLD — WEST MAIN ST
// =========================================================
const WORLD_W=1600, WORLD_H=316;
const ST={ top:124, curb:178, roadBot:266, botWalkBot:308 };

const HOUSES=(()=>{
  const cols=['#cc5540','#eec0ac','#b2cec2','#e0ac42','#9a7a8a','#bd8049','#87a0b0','#d99a6a'];
  const roofc=['#5c4a54','#4a4a5c','#5c544a','#4a5c52'];
  const hs=[]; let x=20,i=0;
  while(x<WORLD_W-90){
    const w=70+Math.floor(rand()*10);
    let special=null;
    if(i===2) special='home';
    else if(i===5) special='helga';
    else if(i===6) special='raccoons';
    else if(i===9) special='catwindow';
    hs.push({x,w,c:i===2?'#38b2aa':cols[i%cols.length],roof:roofc[i%roofc.length],brick:rand()>0.5,special});
    x+=w+4;i++;
  }
  return hs;
})();
function houseBy(sp){ return HOUSES.find(h=>h.special===sp); }

const PROPS=[
  {type:'sign',x:44,y:140},
  {type:'hydrant',x:265,y:146,solid:true},
  {type:'scooters',x:360,y:158,solid:true},
  {type:'trash',x:600,y:140,id:'t1'},
  {type:'trash',x:1010,y:142,id:'t2'},
  {type:'tree',x:190,y:134},{type:'tree',x:510,y:134},
  {type:'tree',x:820,y:134},{type:'tree',x:1130,y:134},{type:'tree',x:1440,y:134},
  {type:'tree',x:350,y:304},{type:'tree',x:900,y:304},{type:'tree',x:1350,y:304},
  {type:'car',x:130,y:206,c:'#9a3644'},{type:'car',x:450,y:206,c:'#476a9c'},
  {type:'car',x:750,y:206,c:'#ddd8cc'},{type:'car',x:1060,y:206,c:'#688448'},
  {type:'car',x:280,y:262,c:'#2c2836'},{type:'car',x:640,y:262,c:'#e0ac42'},
  {type:'car',x:1240,y:262,c:'#845598'},
];

function streetInteractables(){
  const list=[
    {x:360,y:158,r:24,id:'scooters'},
    {x:265,y:146,r:20,id:'hydrant'},
    {x:600,y:140,r:22,id:'trash',tid:'t1'},
    {x:1010,y:142,r:22,id:'trash',tid:'t2'},
    {x:44,y:140,r:20,id:'sign'},
  ];
  const hg=houseBy('helga'); if(hg) list.push({x:hg.x+hg.w/2,y:128,r:28,id:'helga'});
  const rc=houseBy('raccoons'); if(rc) list.push({x:rc.x+rc.w/2,y:128,r:28,id:'raccoons'});
  const cw=houseBy('catwindow'); if(cw) list.push({x:cw.x+cw.w/2,y:128,r:28,id:'catwindow'});
  const hm=houseBy('home'); if(hm) list.push({x:hm.x+hm.w/2,y:128,r:24,id:'home'});
  if(G.ray.met) list.push({x:G.ray.x,y:G.ray.y,r:26,id:'ray'});
  return list;
}

function drawHouse(ctx,h){
  const y0=4, roofH=14, hgt=104;
  px(ctx,h.x-3,y0,h.w+6,roofH,h.roof);
  px(ctx,h.x-3,y0,h.w+6,3,'rgba(255,255,255,.12)');
  px(ctx,h.x-3,y0+roofH-2,h.w+6,2,'rgba(0,0,0,.3)');
  px(ctx,h.x-2,y0+roofH,h.w+4,5,'#3a3244');
  px(ctx,h.x-2,y0+roofH+5,h.w+4,2,'rgba(0,0,0,.25)');
  const fy=y0+roofH+7;
  px(ctx,h.x,fy,h.w,hgt-roofH-7,h.c);
  if(h.brick){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.10)';
    for(let ry=fy+4;ry<y0+hgt;ry+=6)
      for(let rx=h.x+((ry/6)%2?0:3);rx<h.x+h.w-2;rx+=7)
        ctx.fillRect(rx,ry,3,1);
  }
  for(const wx of [h.x+10,h.x+h.w-24]){
    px(ctx,wx-1,fy+8,16,20,'#3a3244');
    px(ctx,wx,fy+9,14,18,'#ffe9a8');
    px(ctx,wx,fy+9,14,6,'#c9dced');
    px(ctx,wx+6,fy+9,2,18,'#3a3244'); px(ctx,wx,fy+17,14,2,'#3a3244');
    px(ctx,wx-2,fy+28,18,2,'#3a3244');
  }
  const dx=h.x+h.w/2-7;
  px(ctx,dx-1,fy+50,16,34,'#3a3244'); px(ctx,dx,fy+51,14,32,'#5f4a35');
  px(ctx,dx+10,fy+66,2,2,'#e8d47a');
  px(ctx,dx-5,fy+84,24,4,'#8f887c'); px(ctx,dx-3,fy+88,20,4,'#a5a093');
  if(h.special==='helga'){
    px(ctx,h.x+6,fy+32,h.w-12,14,'#14121a');
    ctx.fillStyle=(Math.floor(G.t/30)%2)?'#ff7a5c':'#e0533d';
    ctx.font='bold 10px "Courier New",monospace'; ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText("HELGA'S",h.x+h.w/2,fy+42);
    px(ctx,dx-7,fy+50,2,34,'#14121a'); px(ctx,dx+16,fy+50,2,34,'#14121a');
  }
  if(h.special==='raccoons'){
    px(ctx,h.x+6,fy+32,h.w-12,14,'#1d2a1f');
    ctx.fillStyle=(Math.floor(G.t/40)%2)?'#ffd97a':'#e0ac42';
    ctx.font='bold 9px "Courier New",monospace'; ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('4 RACCOONS',h.x+h.w/2,fy+42);
    px(ctx,h.x+h.w/2-16,fy+76,10,12,'#3a3244'); px(ctx,h.x+h.w/2-15,fy+77,8,9,'#2e4034');
    px(ctx,h.x+h.w/2-14,fy+79,6,1,'#f2e9d2'); px(ctx,h.x+h.w/2-14,fy+81,5,1,'#f2e9d2');
  }
  if(h.special==='catwindow'){
    const wx=h.x+10;
    px(ctx,wx+4,fy+19,7,5,'#1d1a22'); px(ctx,wx+4,fy+17,2,2,'#1d1a22'); px(ctx,wx+9,fy+17,2,2,'#1d1a22');
  }
  if(h.special==='home'){
    ctx.fillStyle='#f4efe4'; ctx.font='bold 8px "Courier New",monospace'; ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('2519',h.x+h.w/2,fy+46);
    for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
      const lx=dx-6+i*5;
      px(ctx,lx,fy+48+((i%2)?1:0),2,2,['#e0533d','#e0ac42','#38b2aa'][i%3]);
    }
  }
}
function drawProp(ctx,p){
  if(p.type==='tree'){
    px(ctx,p.x-3,p.y-30,6,30,'#5f4a35'); px(ctx,p.x-3,p.y-30,2,30,'#725a42');
    px(ctx,p.x-13,p.y-48,26,22,'#568056'); px(ctx,p.x-9,p.y-55,18,12,'#699a60');
    px(ctx,p.x-15,p.y-38,5,7,'#477047'); px(ctx,p.x-6,p.y-53,8,3,'#7fb474');
    px(ctx,p.x-9,p.y-2,18,3,'#a3705f');
  }
  else if(p.type==='hydrant'){
    px(ctx,p.x-4,p.y-10,8,10,OUT); px(ctx,p.x-3,p.y-9,6,9,'#cc5540');
    px(ctx,p.x-5,p.y-6,10,2,'#cc5540'); px(ctx,p.x-2,p.y-11,4,2,'#a03c28');
    px(ctx,p.x-3,p.y-4,6,2,'#845598');
  }
  else if(p.type==='scooters'){
    const n=G.flags.scooterKicked?4:5;
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      const sx=p.x-16+i*8,tilt=i%2;
      px(ctx,sx,p.y-12+tilt,2,12,'#38b2aa'); px(ctx,sx-3,p.y-1+tilt,7,2,'#2c2836');
      px(ctx,sx-2,p.y-13+tilt,5,2,'#2c2836');
    }
    if(G.flags.scooterKicked){ px(ctx,p.x+20,p.y-2,12,3,'#38b2aa'); px(ctx,p.x+18,p.y-5,3,3,'#2c2836'); }
  }
  else if(p.type==='trash'){
    px(ctx,p.x-6,p.y-13,12,13,OUT); px(ctx,p.x-5,p.y-12,10,12,'#646c82');
    px(ctx,p.x-7,p.y-14,14,2,'#424a5e');
    px(ctx,p.x-4,p.y-10,1,9,'rgba(255,255,255,.15)');
    if(G.flags.trashLooted[p.id]) px(ctx,p.x+7,p.y-3,5,3,'#8f887c');
  }
  else if(p.type==='car'){
    px(ctx,p.x-1,p.y-16,60,16,OUT);
    px(ctx,p.x,p.y-15,58,13,p.c); px(ctx,p.x+9,p.y-22,36,8,p.c);
    px(ctx,p.x+8,p.y-23,38,1,OUT);
    px(ctx,p.x+11,p.y-21,14,6,'#c4dcee'); px(ctx,p.x+27,p.y-21,16,6,'#c4dcee');
    px(ctx,p.x,p.y-15,58,2,'rgba(255,255,255,.18)');
    px(ctx,p.x+7,p.y-3,9,4,'#14121a'); px(ctx,p.x+43,p.y-3,9,4,'#14121a');
    px(ctx,p.x+8,p.y-3,3,2,'#4a4a5c'); px(ctx,p.x+44,p.y-3,3,2,'#4a4a5c');
    if(p.c==='#ddd8cc') px(ctx,p.x+23,p.y-14,6,4,'#ffe9a8');
  }
  else if(p.type==='sign'){
    px(ctx,p.x,p.y-30,2,30,'#424a5e');
    px(ctx,p.x-16,p.y-34,34,9,'#2e5c3f');
    ctx.fillStyle='#f4efe4'; ctx.font='bold 7px "Courier New",monospace'; ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('W MAIN ST',p.x+1,p.y-27);
  }
}

  px(ctx,184,HOME.wall-14,5,6,'#699a60'); px(ctx,191,HOME.wall-13,5,5,'#699a60');
  px(ctx,50,HOME.h-36,24,12,OUT); px(ctx,52,HOME.h-34,20,8,'#bd8049');
  px(ctx,54,HOME.h-32,16,4,'#8f6236');
  px(ctx,92,HOME.h-14,26,12,'#5f4a35');
  px(ctx,96,HOME.h-10,18,6,'#948b6e');
  ctx.fillStyle='#f2e9d2'; ctx.font='bold 5px monospace'; ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('hey.',105,HOME.h-6);
}

// =========================================================
//  PLAY plumbing
// =========================================================
const gameCv=$('game');
let CTX,SCALE=3,VW=340,VH=220;
function fitCanvas(){
  const W=window.innerWidth,H=window.innerHeight;
  SCALE=Math.max(2,Math.floor(Math.min(W/340,H/220)));
  VW=Math.ceil(W/SCALE); VH=Math.ceil(H/SCALE);
  gameCv.width=VW; gameCv.height=VH;
  gameCv.style.width=(VW*SCALE)+'px'; gameCv.style.height=(VH*SCALE)+'px';
  CTX=gameCv.getContext('2d'); CTX.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
}
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{ fitCanvas(); if(G.mode==='title')drawTitle(); });
fitCanvas();

// ---------- MUSIC : "Fan District Strings" (loops on the block) ----------
const BGM_B64='';
const BGM={ctx:null,buf:null,src:null,gain:null,started:false,el:null};
function bgmBytes(){ const bin=atob(BGM_B64),u=new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)u[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i); return u.buffer; }
function startBGM(){
  if(BGM.started){ if(BGM.ctx&&BGM.ctx.state==='suspended')BGM.ctx.resume(); return; }
  BGM.started=true;
  try{
    const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;
    BGM.ctx=new AC();
    if(BGM.ctx.state==='suspended')BGM.ctx.resume();
    BGM.ctx.decodeAudioData(bgmBytes(),buf=>{
      BGM.gain=BGM.ctx.createGain();BGM.gain.gain.value=0.55;BGM.gain.connect(BGM.ctx.destination);
      BGM.src=BGM.ctx.createBufferSource();BGM.src.buffer=buf;BGM.src.loop=true;
      BGM.src.connect(BGM.gain);BGM.src.start(0);
    },()=>bgmFallback());
  }catch(e){ bgmFallback(); }
}
function bgmFallback(){
  try{
    BGM.el=new Audio(URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bgmBytes()],{type:'audio/mp4'})));
    BGM.el.loop=true;BGM.el.volume=0.55;BGM.el.play().catch(()=>{});
  }catch(e){}
}
// iOS suspends audio contexts on tab-away; wake it back up
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{
  if(!document.hidden&&BGM.ctx&&BGM.ctx.state==='suspended')BGM.ctx.resume();
});

function startPlay(){
  startBGM();
  G.mode='play';
  clearInterval(titleTimer);
  $('hud').classList.add('show');
  $('controls').classList.add('show');
  toast('WEST MAIN ST — the Fan');
  setTimeout(()=>{ if(!G.ray.met && !DLG.active) toast(SCRIPT.street_open_hint,3200); },4000);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
function toast(msg,ms=2600){
  const t=$('toast'); t.textContent=msg; t.style.display='block';
  clearTimeout(t._h); t._h=setTimeout(()=>t.style.display='none',ms);
}

window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{ G.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=true;
  if((e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '||e.key.toLowerCase()==='e')&&G.mode==='play')pressA(); });
window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{ G.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false; });
const joyEl=$('joy'), joyKnob=$('joyKnob'), JOY_R=44;
let joyPid=null;
function joyMove(e){
  const r=joyEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  let jx=e.clientX-(r.left+r.width/2), jy=e.clientY-(r.top+r.height/2);
  const len=Math.hypot(jx,jy);
  if(len>JOY_R){ jx=jx/len*JOY_R; jy=jy/len*JOY_R; }
  joyKnob.style.transform=`translate(${jx}px,${jy}px)`;
  G.joy.x=jx/JOY_R; G.joy.y=jy/JOY_R; G.joy.active=true;
}
function joyReset(e){
  if(joyPid!==e.pointerId)return;
  joyPid=null; G.joy.x=0; G.joy.y=0; G.joy.active=false;
  joyKnob.style.transform=''; joyEl.classList.remove('on');
}
joyEl.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
  e.preventDefault(); joyPid=e.pointerId;
  joyEl.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  joyEl.classList.add('on'); joyMove(e);
});
joyEl.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{ if(joyPid===e.pointerId)joyMove(e); });
joyEl.addEventListener('pointerup',joyReset);
joyEl.addEventListener('pointercancel',joyReset);
$('abtn').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();pressA();});

const DLG={active:false,queue:[],step:null};
const say=(name,text)=>({t:'text',name,text});
const choice=(name,text,options,cb)=>({t:'choice',name,text,options,cb});
const input=(name,text,cb)=>({t:'input',name,text,cb});
const act=fn=>({t:'act',fn});
function runDialogue(steps){ DLG.active=true; DLG.queue=steps.slice(); $('dlg').classList.add('show'); nextStep(); }
function nextStep(){
  const s=DLG.queue.shift();
  if(!s){ endDialogue(); return; }
  DLG.step=s;
  $('dlgChoices').classList.remove('show'); $('dlgChoices').innerHTML='';
  $('dlgInputWrap').classList.remove('show'); $('dlgNext').style.display='none';
  if(s.t==='act'){ s.fn(); nextStep(); return; }
  $('dlgName').textContent=s.name;
  typeText(s.text,()=>{
    if(s.t==='text'){ $('dlgNext').style.display='block'; }
    else if(s.t==='choice'){
      const box=$('dlgChoices'); box.classList.add('show');
      s.options.forEach((op,i)=>{
        const b=document.createElement('button'); b.className='choiceBtn';
        if(op.swatch){ const sw=document.createElement('span'); sw.className='sw'; sw.style.background=op.swatch; b.appendChild(sw); }
        if(op.possum!=null){
          const pc=document.createElement('canvas'); pc.width=52; pc.height=40;
          const g2=pc.getContext('2d'); g2.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
          g2.scale(2,2); drawPossum(g2,13,15,{color:op.possum,accessory:null,accColor:0},0,'right');
          b.appendChild(pc);
        }
        b.appendChild(document.createTextNode(op.label));
        b.addEventListener('click',()=>{ s.cb(i); nextStep(); });
        box.appendChild(b);
      });
    }
    else if(s.t==='input'){
      $('dlgInputWrap').classList.add('show');
      const inp=$('dlgInput'); inp.value=''; setTimeout(()=>inp.focus(),50);
      $('dlgInputOk').onclick=()=>{ s.cb(inp.value.trim()||'Possum'); inp.blur(); nextStep(); };
    }
  });
}
let typeTimer=null;
function typeText(text,done){
  clearInterval(typeTimer);
  const el=$('dlgText'); el.textContent='';
  let i=0;
  typeTimer=setInterval(()=>{
    el.textContent=text.slice(0,++i);
    if(i>=text.length){ clearInterval(typeTimer); typeTimer=null; done(); }
  },14);
  el._full=text; el._done=done;
}
function skipOrAdvance(){
  const el=$('dlgText');
  if(typeTimer){ clearInterval(typeTimer); typeTimer=null; el.textContent=el._full; el._done(); return; }
  if(DLG.step&&DLG.step.t==='text')nextStep();
}
$('dlgBox').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
  if(e.target.closest('.choiceBtn')||e.target.closest('#dlgInputWrap'))return;
  skipOrAdvance();
});
function endDialogue(){ DLG.active=false; $('dlg').classList.remove('show'); }

function currentInteractables(){ return G.map==='street'? streetInteractables() : homeInteractables(); }
function pressA(){
  if(DLG.active){ skipOrAdvance(); return; }
  const p=G.player; let best=null,bd=1e9;
  for(const it of currentInteractables()){
    const d=Math.hypot(it.x-p.x,it.y-p.y);
    if(d<it.r+10&&d<bd){bd=d;best=it;}
  }
  if(best)handleInteract(best);
}
function handleInteract(it){
  const buddy=G.possum?G.possum.name:null;
  switch(it.id){
    case 'sign': runDialogue([say('SIGN',SCRIPT.sign)]); break;
    case 'hydrant': runDialogue([say('HYDRANT',SCRIPT.hydrant)]); break;
    case 'scooters':
      if(!G.flags.scooterKicked){
        runDialogue([
          say('SCOOTERS',SCRIPT.scooters_1),
          choice('SCOOTERS',SCRIPT.scooters_ask,[{label:SCRIPT.scooters_yes},{label:SCRIPT.scooters_no}],
            i=>{ if(i===0){G.flags.scooterKicked=true; G.rep+=1; updateHUD(); toast(SCRIPT.scooters_toast);} })
        ]);
      } else runDialogue([say('SCOOTERS',SCRIPT.scooters_after)]);
      break;
    case 'trash':
      if(G.possum&&!G.flags.trashLooted[it.tid]){
        G.flags.trashLooted[it.tid]=true; G.coins+=3; updateHUD();
        runDialogue([say(buddy.toUpperCase(),SCRIPT.trash_loot(buddy))]);
      } else if(G.possum) runDialogue([say('TRASH',SCRIPT.trash_empty(buddy))]);
      else runDialogue([say('TRASH',SCRIPT.trash_nobuddy)]);
      break;
    case 'helga': runDialogue([say("HELGA'S",SCRIPT.helga_1),say("HELGA'S",SCRIPT.helga_2)]); break;
    case 'raccoons': runDialogue([say('4 RACCOONS',SCRIPT.raccoons_1),say('4 RACCOONS',SCRIPT.raccoons_2)]); break;
    case 'catwindow': runDialogue([say('WINDOW CAT',SCRIPT.catwindow)]); break;
    case 'home': enterHome(); break;
    case 'ray': {
      const lines=SCRIPT.ray_idle.slice();
      if(buddy) lines.splice(3,1,SCRIPT.ray_idle_buddy(buddy));
      runDialogue([say(SCRIPT.ray_name,lines[G.flags.rayIdle++%lines.length])]);
      break; }
    case 'mirror':
      runDialogue([choice('MIRROR',SCRIPT.mirror_prompt,
        [{label:SCRIPT.mirror_yes},{label:SCRIPT.mirror_no}],
        i=>{ if(i===0) setTimeout(()=>openCreator(true),80); })]);
      break;
    case 'bed': runDialogue([say('BED',SCRIPT.bed)]); break;
    case 'window_home': runDialogue([say('WINDOW',SCRIPT.window_home)]); break;
    case 'basket': runDialogue([say('BASKET',SCRIPT.basket(buddy))]); break;
    case 'plant': runDialogue([say('PLANT',SCRIPT.plant)]); break;
    case 'exit': exitHome(); break;
  }
}

function enterHome(){
  const hm=houseBy('home');
  G.homeReturn={x:hm.x+hm.w/2, y:136};
  G.map='home';
  G.player.x=HOME.w/2; G.player.y=HOME.h-24; G.player.dir='up';
  G.trail.length=0;
  if(G.possum){ G.possum.x=G.player.x-14; G.possum.y=G.player.y; }
  toast(SCRIPT.home_enter_toast);
}
function exitHome(){
  G.map='street';
  G.player.x=G.homeReturn.x; G.player.y=G.homeReturn.y; G.player.dir='down';
  G.trail.length=0;
  if(G.possum){ G.possum.x=G.player.x-14; G.possum.y=G.player.y; }
  toast(SCRIPT.home_exit_toast);
}

function rayCutscene(){
  const chosen={color:1,accessory:'Bandana',accColor:0,name:'Possum'};
  const steps=SCRIPT.ray_intro.map(([n,t])=>say(n,t));
  steps.push(
    choice(SCRIPT.ray_name,SCRIPT.ray_pick,[
      {label:POSSUM_COLORS[0].n,possum:0},
      {label:POSSUM_COLORS[1].n,possum:1},
      {label:POSSUM_COLORS[2].n,possum:2},
    ],i=>{chosen.color=i;}),
    say(SCRIPT.ray_name,SCRIPT.ray_picked),
    choice(SCRIPT.ray_name,SCRIPT.ray_drip,
      ACCESSORIES.map(a=>({label:a})),i=>{chosen.accessory=ACCESSORIES[i];}),
    choice(SCRIPT.ray_name,SCRIPT.ray_dripcolor,
      ACC_COLORS.map(c=>({label:c.n,swatch:c.c})),i=>{chosen.accColor=i;}),
    input(SCRIPT.ray_name,SCRIPT.ray_askname,nm=>{chosen.name=nm;}),
    act(()=>{
      G.possum={...chosen,trail:[]};
      updateHUD();
      DLG.queue.unshift(
        say(SCRIPT.ray_name,SCRIPT.ray_christen(G.possum.name)),
        ...SCRIPT.ray_outro.map(([n,t])=>say(n,t)),
        act(()=>{ toast(SCRIPT.possum_joined(G.possum.name)); G.ray.met=true; })
      );
    })
  );
  runDialogue(steps);
}

function updateHUD(){
  $('hudRep').textContent='R '+G.rep;
  $('hudCoins').textContent='¢ '+G.coins;
  $('hudHealth').textContent='♥ '+'▮'.repeat(G.health);
  if(G.possum){
    const b=$('hudBuddy'); b.style.display='block';
    b.textContent=G.possum.name+' the possum';
  }
}

function loop(){
  if(G.mode!=='play'){ requestAnimationFrame(loop); return; }
  G.t++;
  update(); render();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

function update(){
  const p=G.player;
  const creatorOpen=$('creator').classList.contains('show');
  if(!DLG.active && !creatorOpen){
    let dx=0,dy=0;
    if(G.keys['arrowleft']||G.keys['a'])dx-=1;
    if(G.keys['arrowright']||G.keys['d'])dx+=1;
    if(G.keys['arrowup']||G.keys['w'])dy-=1;
    if(G.keys['arrowdown']||G.keys['s'])dy+=1;
    if(G.joy.active){ dx=G.joy.x; dy=G.joy.y; }
    const mag=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
    p.moving=mag>0.18;
    if(p.moving){
      if(Math.abs(dx)>=Math.abs(dy))p.dir=dx<0?'left':'right';
      else p.dir=dy<0?'up':'down';
      const spd=p.speed*Math.min(1,mag);
      let nx=p.x+dx/mag*spd, ny=p.y+dy/mag*spd;
      if(G.map==='street'){
        nx=clamp(nx,12,WORLD_W-12); ny=clamp(ny,ST.top+6,ST.botWalkBot-4);
        let blocked=false;
        for(const pr of PROPS){
          if(pr.type==='scooters'&&Math.hypot(pr.x-nx,pr.y-5-ny)<16)blocked=true;
          if(pr.type==='hydrant'&&Math.hypot(pr.x-nx,pr.y-4-ny)<9)blocked=true;
          if(pr.type==='car'&&nx>pr.x-8&&nx<pr.x+66&&ny>pr.y-20&&ny<pr.y+3)blocked=true;
          if(pr.type==='tree'&&Math.hypot(pr.x-nx,pr.y-3-ny)<7)blocked=true;
        }
        if(!blocked){p.x=nx;p.y=ny;}
      } else {
        nx=clamp(nx,12,HOME.w-12); ny=clamp(ny,HOME.wall+6,HOME.h-10);
        let blocked=false;
        if(nx>142&&ny>HOME.wall+18&&ny<HOME.wall+58)blocked=true;
        if(nx>46&&nx<78&&ny>HOME.h-40&&ny<HOME.h-22)blocked=true;
        if(!blocked){p.x=nx;p.y=ny;}
        if(p.y>HOME.h-14&&Math.abs(p.x-HOME.w/2)<14){ exitHome(); return; }
      }
      p.frame++;
      G.trail.push({x:p.x,y:p.y});
      if(G.trail.length>40)G.trail.shift();
    }
  }
  const r=G.ray;
  if(G.map==='street'){
    if(!r.met&&!r.approaching&&!DLG.active&&Math.abs(p.x-r.x)<80)r.approaching=true;
    if(r.approaching&&!r.met){
      const d=Math.hypot(p.x-r.x,p.y-r.y);
      if(d>30&&!DLG.active){
        r.x+=(p.x-r.x)/d*1.15; r.y+=(p.y-r.y)/d*1.15;
        r.dir=p.x<r.x?'left':'right'; r.frame++;
      } else if(!DLG.active){ r.approaching=false; rayCutscene(); }
    }
  }
  if(G.possum){
    const target=G.trail[Math.max(0,G.trail.length-14)]||{x:p.x-14,y:p.y};
    const ps=G.possum;
    ps.x=ps.x==null?p.x-14:ps.x+(target.x-ps.x)*0.18;
    ps.y=ps.y==null?p.y:ps.y+(target.y-ps.y)*0.18;
    ps.dir=(target.x<ps.x-0.3)?'left':(target.x>ps.x+0.3?'right':ps.dir||'right');
    ps.frame=(ps.frame||0)+(p.moving?1:0);
  }
  if(G.map==='street'){
    G.camX=clamp(p.x-VW/2,0,WORLD_W-VW);
    G.camY = WORLD_H>VH ? clamp(p.y-VH/2,0,WORLD_H-VH) : -Math.round((VH-WORLD_H)/2);
  }
}

function render(){
  const c=CTX;
  if(G.map==='street'){
    c.fillStyle='#0f0d16'; c.fillRect(0,0,VW,VH);
    c.save(); c.translate(-Math.round(G.camX),-Math.round(G.camY));
    c.fillStyle='#9cc0d4'; c.fillRect(G.camX-4,-300,VW+8,304);
    c.fillStyle='#b98d7c'; c.fillRect(0,ST.top,WORLD_W,ST.curb-ST.top);
    c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.08)';
    for(let y=ST.top+2;y<ST.curb;y+=5)
      for(let x=((y/5)%2?0:4);x<WORLD_W;x+=9)c.fillRect(x,y,4,1);
    c.fillStyle='#8f887c'; c.fillRect(0,ST.curb,WORLD_W,3);
    c.fillStyle='#484852'; c.fillRect(0,ST.curb+3,WORLD_W,ST.roadBot-ST.curb-3);
    c.fillStyle='#3e3e48';
    for(let x=0;x<WORLD_W;x+=40) c.fillRect(x,ST.curb+3,20,ST.roadBot-ST.curb-3);
    c.fillStyle='#e0ac42';
    for(let x=6;x<WORLD_W;x+=26)c.fillRect(x,(ST.curb+ST.roadBot)/2,12,2);
    c.fillStyle='#8f887c'; c.fillRect(0,ST.roadBot,WORLD_W,3);
    c.fillStyle='#b98d7c'; c.fillRect(0,ST.roadBot+3,WORLD_W,ST.botWalkBot-ST.roadBot-3);
    c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.08)';
    for(let y=ST.roadBot+5;y<ST.botWalkBot;y+=5)
      for(let x=((y/5)%2?0:4);x<WORLD_W;x+=9)c.fillRect(x,y,4,1);
    c.fillStyle='#568056'; c.fillRect(0,ST.botWalkBot,WORLD_W,WORLD_H-ST.botWalkBot+200);
    c.fillStyle='#477047';
    for(let x=0;x<WORLD_W;x+=14) c.fillRect(x,ST.botWalkBot+3,7,2);
    for(const h of HOUSES)drawHouse(c,h);
    const ents=[];
    for(const pr of PROPS)ents.push({y:pr.y,draw:()=>drawProp(c,pr)});
    ents.push({y:G.player.y,draw:()=>drawPlayerWorld(c)});
    ents.push({y:G.ray.y,draw:()=>{
      drawRayChibi(c,G.ray.x,G.ray.y,G.ray.frame,G.ray.dir);
      if(!G.ray.met){
        px(c,G.ray.x+12,G.ray.y-9,16,9,'#bd8049'); px(c,G.ray.x+12,G.ray.y-10,16,2,'#8f6236');
        for(let i=0;i<3;i++)px(c,G.ray.x+14+i*5,G.ray.y-13,4,4,POSSUM_COLORS[i].body);
        if(Math.floor(G.t/20)%2){ c.fillStyle='#e0533d'; c.font='bold 11px monospace'; c.textAlign='center';
          c.fillText('!',G.ray.x,G.ray.y-34); }
      }
    }});
    if(G.possum&&G.possum.x!=null)
      ents.push({y:G.possum.y-0.1,draw:()=>drawPossum(c,G.possum.x,G.possum.y,G.possum,G.possum.frame,G.possum.dir)});
    ents.sort((a,b)=>a.y-b.y).forEach(e=>e.draw());
    drawPromptWorld(c);
    c.restore();
  } else {
    c.fillStyle='#14121a'; c.fillRect(0,0,VW,VH);
    const ox=Math.round((VW-HOME.w)/2), oy=Math.round((VH-HOME.h)/2);
    c.save(); c.translate(ox,oy);
    drawHome(c);
    const ents=[];
    ents.push({y:G.player.y,draw:()=>drawPlayerWorld(c)});
    if(G.possum&&G.possum.x!=null)
      ents.push({y:G.possum.y-0.1,draw:()=>drawPossum(c,G.possum.x,G.possum.y,G.possum,G.possum.frame,G.possum.dir)});
    ents.sort((a,b)=>a.y-b.y).forEach(e=>e.draw());
    drawPromptWorld(c);
    c.restore();
  }
}
function drawPromptWorld(c){
  if(DLG.active)return;
  const p=G.player;
  for(const it of currentInteractables()){
    if(Math.hypot(it.x-p.x,it.y-p.y)<it.r+10){
      px(c,p.x-8,p.y-33,16,11,'rgba(20,18,26,.8)');
      c.fillStyle='#f4efe4'; c.font='bold 8px monospace'; c.textAlign='center';
      c.fillText('A',p.x,p.y-24.5);
      break;
    }
  }
}

updateHUD();
</script>
</body>
</html>
